rows.definition: Per-layer binder on the V4.1 cold-compressor panel that routes completed ratio >= 2 compressor groups through the device-side gated compressor pool.
rows.distinction: The binding action that installs the pool callback per layer; it is not the gatedPool callback field it sets, nor an expert gate/up dispatch seam.

rows.definition: Commit-time build-check gate runner that executes the changed-package build check and reports a typed safecommit.BuildCheckOutcome plus diagnostic detail without deciding the commit's fate.
rows.distinction: Runs and reports the pre-commit build check; it neither owns the commit decision (safecommit.DecideBuildCheck) nor the FLEET_BUILDCHECK_GUARD env toggle that disables the fleet-wide check.

rows.definition: Compile-time build flag (--v41-engram-gate) selecting the explicit SM120 V4.1 Engram-gate candidate; public capability remains unqualified.
rows.distinction: A build selection flag, not the V41EngramGate backend op it qualifies nor the engramGateFunc accessor that hands out the bound device function.

rows.definition: Device gather-ops accessor returning the session-bound V4.1 Engram gate function pointer used by the forward layer when the panel stays device-resident.
rows.distinction: An accessor over the bound device callback, not the V41EngramGate backend op itself nor the build flag that compiles the candidate.

rows.definition: GGUF tensor-name suffix in DeepSeek 4.1 / GLM / Qwen4-exp manifests that maps onto the shared-experts gate projection ffn.shared_experts.w1.weight.
rows.distinction: The shared-experts gate tensor name, not the MoE router gate (ffn.gate / ffn_gate_inp) nor the up/down shared-expert tensors.

rows.definition: Environment variable (FLEET_BUILDCHECK_GUARD=off) that disables the fleet-wide commit build-check guard, set alongside FAK_COMMIT_BUILD_CHECK during fak commit runs.
rows.distinction: An env toggle for the fleet build-check guard, not the commitBuildCheckGate runner itself nor the typed BuildCheckOutcome that runner emits.

rows.definition: Transient device buffer holding the gate half of a split Qwen3.5 [query, gate] projection in CUDA and Vulkan decode paths.
rows.distinction: A scratch buffer for the split gate component, not the query-gate projection weight concept nor the SplitQwen35QueryGate op that produces the split.

rows.definition: Gated DeltaNet linear-attention/SSM layer family (ggml op GATED_DELTA_NET) used by Qwen3.5-class models, with a parallel host recurrence fallback.
rows.distinction: A recurrent linear-attention layer class, not a single attention gate projection (q_gate_proj) nor an attention output-gate flag.

rows.definition: Callback field on V41CompressorPool that routes completed ratio >= 2 compressor groups through the device pool, inherited by replay panels.
rows.distinction: The pool-routing callback state, not the bindGatedPool action that installs it per layer, nor a batched gated-MLP compute path.

rows.definition: Advisory commit-boundary hook gate (internal/hooks/gate_importwitness.go) that catches committed files importing a module-local package with zero tracked or staged non-test .go files.
rows.distinction: The import-witness commit gate, not the generic git-hook gate class nor the GUARD_MCP_STATUS audit gate in the same hooks package.

rows.definition: devexmeter gate function that grades one issue candidate against measured developer-experience rows and returns a GateResult.
rows.distinction: An issue-dispatchability grader in devexmeter, not the generic gate decision point nor an advisory gate verdict.

rows.definition: Boolean result flag (JSON gate_passed) recorded on benchmark and receipt structs - frontierswe Correctness and nativeperf reproducibility - stating whether the applicable quality gate passed.
rows.distinction: A recorded pass/fail flag on results, not the gate mechanism itself nor a gate verdict type.

rows.definition: Lesson-series citation (gateshare/fak/lesson-N) in dispatch-status code pinning how gate/share throughput metrics fold into the fleet dispatch card, headline first.
rows.distinction: A documentation citation for dispatch tick share metrics, not a gate implementation nor the gateStats counters it describes.

rows.definition: Weight-tensor handle for the MLP gate projection (mlp.gate_proj.weight) used by Qwen3.5 Metal decode blocks and V4 expert-shared paths.
rows.distinction: A loaded weight handle, not the gate_proj tensor-name concept nor the fused gate_up_proj pair.

rows.definition: Safetensors tensor suffix naming the GPT-OSS expert gate/up bias, materialized as mlp.experts.gate_up_proj.bias during weight loading.
rows.distinction: The bias tensor of the fused gate/up pair, not the gate/up weight pair itself nor a single gate_proj.

rows.definition: Control-pane corpus key (DebtKey) the guard-accuracy fold writes the headline accuracy-debt count into.
rows.distinction: A reported debt counter key, not the guardaccuracy accuracy corpus that feeds it nor the guard-RSI fold.

rows.definition: Placeholder API-key value injected into locally launched Codex children when no real key is present, enabling break-glass local recovery.
rows.distinction: The local-placeholder key constant, not the OAuth placeholder key twin nor the FAK_GUARD_API_KEY_ENV env knob.

rows.definition: Public pkg (pkg/guardedremotemaint) providing the guarded remote-maintenance agent-session facade whose kernel boundary routes verdicts through the adjudication ABI.
rows.distinction: A remote-maintenance session facade package, not the fak guard kernel nor a decision-point gate.

rows.definition: Watchdog measurement (tools/guard_hop_rsi.py, ported to platform/watchdogs) whose PENDING_MEASUREMENT/check_plan fencing the guard-RSI fold reads as latency-loop honesty evidence.
rows.distinction: The hop-latency RSI measurement rung, not the guardrsi fold that consumes it nor the guard RSI CLI verbs.

rows.definition: Hook gate (byte-faithful port of tools/guard_mcp_status_audit.py) auditing the guard/MCP proof packet against current evidence artifacts such as default-floor tests and dogfood denials.
rows.distinction: The MCP-status audit gate, not the guardMcpStatusAudit helper it wraps nor the import-witness commit gate.

rows.definition: First-class `fak guard -- pi` child wiring (cmd/fak/guard_pi.go) that prepends a session-scoped extension registering the anthropic provider at the gateway for Pi children only.
rows.distinction: The Pi-specific child launch extension, not the installGuardPiExtension install record nor the guard kernel generally.

rows.definition: Constructor building a TokenRateGate under a TokenRatePolicy - one provider budget's rolling-window token/concurrency admission gate for the served path.

rows.definition: Self-update receipt outcome alias (selfupdate.OutcomeGateFailed, wire value gate-failed) marking that the update gate refused the rotation.
rows.distinction: A selfupdate receipt outcome, not the OPERATOR_GATE refusal-reason category nor the gateway StopGate.

rows.definition: workerworktree gate callback (func(context.Context) error) consulted before preparing a preserving worktree so existing peers' state is never altered without proof.
rows.distinction: The preserving-worktree preparation gate, not the rehearsal PreflightGate nor a generic decision point.

rows.definition: Grandfathered installer script (tools/register_proc_resource_guard.ps1) that registers the FleetProcResourceGuard scheduled task, inventoried by taskvc and restarted by watchdog autoheal.
rows.distinction: The task-registration script, not the FleetProcResourceGuard guard it installs nor the trunk guard.

rows.definition: devcmd handler behind the `fak-dev gate` companion verb that runs the companion bridge's gate checks.

rows.definition: CLI handler for `fak guard allow --approve` that approves pending guard allow-list entries with TTL and conflict handling.
rows.distinction: The approve-path handler, not the guard allow subcommand surface nor the allow-overlay schema it persists.

rows.definition: Documentation heading term (research notes) naming the protective measures and circuit breakers that bound a study or cadence.
rows.distinction: A prose heading word, not the guardrail safety-boundary concept nor the guardrail rule catalog.

rows.distinction: The split-carving suffix constant, not the gate_proj tensor concept nor the fused gate_up_proj pair.

rows.definition: cmd/fak guard_test.go regression pinning that the guard default policy denies dangerous git operations and allows benign ones.
rows.distinction: The default-policy behavior test, not the embedded default policy JSON it exercises nor the guard entry point.

rows.definition: Compute-backend op implementing the DeepSeek V4.1 Engram gate/add over the device-resident mHC stream panel, bit-exact against the host full-geometry arithmetic.
rows.distinction: The gate op itself, not the cudaV41EngramGate CUDA implementation twin nor the V41EngramGateBackend interface declaring it.

rows.definition: Optional compute-backend interface exposing the V4.1 Engram gate op and its SupportsV41EngramGate capability probe.

rows.definition: Model-side parameter-validation error helper for the V4.1 Engram gate (layer, eps, qNorm, kNorm) checked before lookahead gather.

rows.definition: Function type of the optional V4.1 device expert gate+up projection callback invoked per routed-expert group in the MoE forward.
rows.distinction: The callback function type, not the expertGateUp session state that holds it nor its v41ExpertGateUpOutcome return.

rows.definition: Outcome type returned by the V4.1 expert gate-up callback: handled, declined, or error.
rows.distinction: The outcome type, not one of its constants (v41GateUpDeclined) nor the callback function type producing it.

rows.distinction: One outcome constant, not the whole v41ExpertGateUpOutcome type nor the callback that returns it.

rows.definition: Shared operand/geometry validator for the V41EngramGate backend op bounding rows/hidden and checking unquantized row-major F32 operands before dispatch.

rows.definition: Geometry validator for the V41RouterGateTopK backend op checking weight/x/bias shapes and experts/hidden/topK bounds before device routing.
rows.distinction: The router-gate-topK validator, not the generic gate decision point nor the expert gate-up callback validation.
